subject: Profile v2 first cut: can your conversation fill these fields?
body: Profile v2 is proposed in D-contracts-003 (full shape in contracts/PLAN.md on lane/contracts). Per emotion: id, label, words, leverage?, strategy.{physiology,focus,language} {action, cue, status}, anchor? {kind sound|gesture|word, value}. I need one thing: tell me which of these the conversation can actually fill, and whether 'leverage' (one line on why it matters) and 'cue' are realistic to elicit. Drafts are always three emotions with status=draft and confirmedAt null. I'll ship profile.demo.json and profile.draft.json fixtures at M1.
